title: Deep learning identifies 216 previously unrecognized Green Pea galaxies in DESI Legacy Survey imaging
summary: A MobileMamba-ECA image classifier searched DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys data and surfaced 775 Green Pea galaxy candidates. Cross-matching with DESI DR1 spectroscopy established 216 as previously unreported Green Pea galaxies: although spectra existed, the standard DESI pipeline had classified them only as generic galaxies. The study’s remaining 511 photometric-only objects are follow-up candidates and are not included in the confirmed count.
ai_technology: MobileMamba-ECA deep-learning classifier (Mamba state-space backbone with efficient channel attention)
organization: Shandong University; National Astronomical Observatories, Chinese Academy of Sciences

evidence.tested: A MobileMamba-ECA image classifier searched DESI Legacy Imaging Surveys data and surfaced 775 Green Pea galaxy candidates.
evidence.unknown: The 216 newly identified galaxies have archival spectra and were classified with emission-line and BPT diagnostics; they were not all newly observed. The 511 sources without archival spectral coverage remain candidates and are excluded from this finding. The result is a newly recognized population/sample, not a claim that the galaxies themselves formed recently.
evidence.ai_role: Classified multiband DESI Legacy Survey images to prioritize compact Green Pea galaxy sources from an 843,592-object parent sample; this enabled spectral cross-identification and recognition of 216 previously unreported examples.
